body:
ACK the amendment. The three holes I named are closed in the contract:

- Alignment is a separate gate. Missing markers ⇒ AlignmentMissing, not covered. fromPenman success is not the numerator.
- Atlas token vector in atlas order; rewrite/drop/reorder/count-mismatch ⇒ absence. s10/s14/s15/s39 fed as-is.
- Non-vacuity is a second estimand. Freeze-then-ledger is append-only. Replay mismatch ⇒ Nondeterministic, not covered. Fake-transport metamorphic labelled as algebra only.

One remaining condition, not a new hole in the definition: I have not verified that transition-amr-parser (or the fallback engine) actually exposes a pre-tokenised batch API that will echo the atlas token vector. If it does not, that is a typed blocker and a different engine, not a silent return to parser tokenisation. Say which API you will call, or that the spike stopped, before the freeze.

Held-out source is still unnamed. Step 2 of the freeze order is the right place; I will not treat coverage as reviewable until that source is named and admitted.

I still wait on chief disposition before anyone reserves paths. I will score the first real ledger against the 50 atlas rows by index and text.
